title: System Settings
unsavedMessage: You have unsaved settings on this page. Save them?
unsavedHasErrors: There are validation errors. Go back to fix them, or discard all changes.

validate.header: {n} item(s) need to be fixed before saving
validate.invalidUrl: Must start with http:// or https://

monitoring.title: Host monitoring
monitoring.desc: Set the collection interval and data retention period for all hosts.

smtp.title: SMTP Email
smtp.desc: Configure SMTP server for sending notification emails.
smtp.testHint: Send a test email using current (including unsaved) SMTP values.
smtp.testInvalid: Please enter a valid email address

branding.title: Site Appearance
branding.desc: Customize system name, branding, and page elements.
branding.tutorialUrl_tip: When set, a “Tutorials” entry appears in the user sidebar and opens this URL in a new tab. Leave empty to hide.
branding.allowRegistration_tip: When disabled, the sign-up button is hidden and only admins can create users.

support.title: Online Support
support.desc: Manage support contacts, service information, and chat welcome messages.
support.footerNote_tip: Displayed below the contact list. Use for business hours or any custom note. Leave empty to hide.

agreements.title: User Agreements
agreements.subtitle_tos: Explain service scope, usage rules, and the rights and responsibilities of both parties.
agreements.subtitle_privacy: Explain how personal information is collected, used, and protected.
agreements.default_checked: Check agreements by default at registration
agreements.default_checked_tip: When enabled, the registration form's agreement checkbox is checked by default. Users can still uncheck it.

payment.title: Payment Channels

gatewayDescriptions.hupijiao: Collect website order payments through Hupijiao.
gatewayDescriptions.alipay_direct: Collect order payments directly with your Alipay merchant account.
gatewayDescriptions.wechat_pay: Collect order payments by QR code, in WeChat, or through the payment mini program.

wechat.officialAccountDesc: Service account credentials for payments within WeChat.
wechat.miniProgramDesc: Mini program credentials for mobile order payments.

credentials.title: Gateway Credentials
credentials.desc: Application, merchant identity, and authentication details for the payment platform.

urls.title: Payment Endpoints
urls.desc: Request origin and endpoints for connecting to Hupijiao.

payment.referer_tip: Referer header sent with payment requests, usually your site root URL.
payment.gatewayEndpoints_tip: Comma-separated fallback endpoints tried in order.

quotas.title: Payment & Refund Time Limits
quotas.desc: Set payment validity and the time limit for overdue refund alerts.

payment.payTimeout_tip: QR code validity is capped at 5 minutes. Keeping it at 5 is recommended.
payment.refundStuckHours_tip: Refunds pending longer than this become manual incidents.

alipay.gatewayDesc: Configure Alipay open-platform gateway and seller PID.

defaults.title: Server Defaults
defaults.desc: Default resources and presets when creating new servers.

time.title: Task Timezone
time.desc: The timezone for scheduled suspension, deletion, and email reminders.

suspend.title: Auto Suspend
suspend.desc: Schedule suspension of expired servers to manage access after service expiry.

delete.title: Auto Delete
delete.desc: Remove suspended servers past their retention period to release host resources.

email.title: Expiration Email Reminder
email.desc: Automatically send reminder emails before server expiration

referral.title: Referral Rewards
referral.desc: Grant a coupon to both inviter and invitee after the invitee's first qualifying paid order.
referral.enabledHint: When off, referrals are still recorded but no coupons are auto-granted.
referral.inviterTemplateHint: Coupon template granted to the inviter (an existing user). Only active templates are listed; create or edit them under Billing · Coupon Templates.
referral.inviteeTemplateHint: Coupon template granted to the invitee (the newly registered user). Only active templates are listed; create or edit them under Billing · Coupon Templates.
referral.minFenHint: Rewards are only granted when the order's paid amount is at least this much. Set 0.01 to allow any paid order; raise to filter tiny orders and prevent abuse.
referral.qualifyingKindsHint: Only orders of the selected kinds trigger rewards. Deselect to exclude that order kind.

general.title: Included Plan Quota
general.desc: Provide model usage quota with plans that include LLM benefits.
general.enabledHint: When enabled, users subscribing to plans with LLM quota will receive a free LLM API key, automatically injected into their SillyTavern container.

connection.title: NewAPI Connection
connection.desc: Connect to the NewAPI service that manages user keys and model quotas.

injection.title: SillyTavern Endpoint
injection.desc: The API address SillyTavern uses to access model services.
